description: Intercept malicious instructions hiding in webpages, email, PDFs, and tool outputs before they reach your agent.
notes: Shared kit landed mid-build; re-targeted to the real shared/kit.js contract.

notes.note: 'Prompt injection is the XSS of the agent era' is a great analogy and a real problem. But it's also the single most crowded sentence in AI security right now — every vendor, framework, and cloud has a prompt-shield story, and gateways get absorbed into the platforms that own the traffic. The standalone API-scan business competes with free.
Scan/reset/copy-sanitized all work; findings + quarantine render; zero errors.

notes.change: Added two more attack samples (phishing email, tool output) with nav-bar switcher; each loads and auto-scans.
